charts.title: G 9-40 b: orbits around G 9-40
charts.description: The orbits of G 9-40's planets in this map from above, to scale, with G 9-40 b highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

metadata.orbitSource: Luque et al. 2022 (2022A&A...666A.154L), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname LUQUE_ET_AL__2022): P 5.7459982 d

charts.title: G 9-40 b: its transit
charts.description: G 9-40 b crossing its star, as TESS recorded it: 3 sectors (45, 46, 72) of the SPOC pipeline's 2-minute light curves of TIC 203214081, each transit divided by a straight line fitted to the light either side and folded onto the orbit the app draws, then averaged in 7-minute bins. Error bars are each bin's standard error.
notes: Folded on the app's orbit; 7-min bins.
Bars: standard error of each bin.
